D.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes. Recommendation: Approve minutes of regular meeting on February 24, 2014 as written.
D-1. Feb 24 UB Minutes
2.
Acceptance of Grant of Easement from Azusa Land Reclamation, Inc. Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. 14-C19 accepting Grant of Easement for the property at 1501 West Gladstone Street - Material Recovery Facility and authorize the City Clerk to file it in the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder. A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA ACCEPTING A CERTAIN GRANT OF PERMANENT EASEMENT AND DIRECTING THE RECORDING THEREOF.
D-2.1. Grant of Easement-ALR
D-2.2. Resolution & Exhibits
3.
Award Bid Contract to VCI Construction, Inc. for Furnishing and Installing Underground Electric Substructures in Accordance to Project LD2013-10. Recommendation: Award a contract to VCI Construction, Incorporated in the amount not-to-exceed $139,784.70 to furnish and install underground substructures along Foothill Boulevard and Dalton Avenue as per plan and specifications for Project # LD2013-10.
D-3.1. Contract Award- Elec UG Project
D-3.2. VCI Proposal- Elec UG Project
4.
Approval to Purchase Required Local Resource Adequacy Capacity for 2015 from NRG Energy. Recommendation: Approve a Local Resource Adequacy Capacity purchase of 29 MW
for calendar year 2015 from NRG Energy and authorize the Director of Utilities to execute the
associated Confirmation Agreement.
D-4. Local RAC Purchase 2015
E.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
Report on Cost Study of How Landfill Closure Affected Incremental Operating Costs of Athens Services. Recommendation: (1) Review and approve the consultant's findings with respect to Athens' increased costs to haul waste to the Mid Valley Landfill, El Sobrante Landfill, and Recycled Wood Products facility; (2) Continue to have Athens Services transfer Azusa's waste to the Mid Valley in Rialto; (3) Direct staff to incorporate increased operating costs into the annual refuse rate adjustment based on attached report, including commitment by Athens Services as noted in this report, and prepare notice for public hearing in June 2014 for approval of refuse rate adjustment; and (4) Adopt Resolution No. 14-C20 approving budget amendment in amount of $140,000 in account 39-40-750-065-6625 and authorize payment to Athens for its increased cost of processing waste for period of November 1, 2013 through June 30, 2014. A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL/UTILITY BOARD OF THE CITY OF AZUSA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2013-2014 OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE AB 939 FEE FUND TO PAY FOR ADDITIONAL WASTE PROCESSING AND TRANSFER COSTS.
E-1.1. Waste Processing and Disposal Cost Analysis
E-1.2. Reso-Budget Amdmnt re Landfill Closure

Approval of Amendments to Power Sales Agreements ("PSA") with Southern California Public Power Authority ("SCPPA") for Long Term Purchase of Energy, Capacity, and Environmental Attributes Sourced from Solar Projects Developed by Silverado Power. Recommendation: Approve the attached amendments to the existing Power Sales Agreements with SCPPA for long term purchase of renewable energy and capacity and authorize Mayor to execute such.
